_comment: Published per WP-SCP-022 020H.1 (closes 020H part 3 (xi) freshness-warning forward-looking flag). The reusable workflow's freshness-warning step compares this manifest at SCP main HEAD against the manifest at the wrapper's SHA pin (in .scp-runtime/version-manifest.json) and emits ::warning:: when the wrapper is more than `freshness_warning_threshold_minor` minor versions behind. The threshold is read from the PINNED manifest, not from main HEAD (closes 020H.1 R1 SAFE-MIN-006). Bump `version` + `minor` + `released_at` together on every release. See policies/VERSIONING.md for the semver contract. v1.5.0 introduces WP-SCP-028 Phase 1 (D-058 first auth domain) — three new domain rules: SCP-R-009 (auth-canonical-version-pin), SCP-R-010 (auth-canonical-import-fence; two-tier), SCP-R-011 (auth-contract-claim-shape); all warn-baseline. Additive-rule MINOR. The rules ship loaded but vacuous-pass in production until a companion workflow PR materialises input.canonical_sdk_versions + input.auth_contract (cosign-verified via the .sig.bundle anchor) + input.adopter_* into the evaluation envelope and adds them to WARN_BASELINE_RULES (the SCP-R-006/R-030 safe-failure precedent). D-059 reserved for the post-4-week-observation deny-promotion outcome. (v1.4.0 was WP-SCP-030 Phase B.1 / SCP-R-030.) v1.5.1 is a PATCH bugfix: the workflow's manifest target-prep step emitted SCP-E002 and hard-failed the required gate when an adopter PR DELETED a manifest (package.json / pyproject.toml / go.mod) — the adopter-mode `git diff --name-only` enumeration includes deletions, and a removed manifest has no surface to evaluate or attest. The fix skips deleted manifests; the target-prep logic was extracted into lib/policy_check_invocation.sh (an internal surface per VERSIONING.md §Scope) as scp_policy_check_prepare_manifest_targets so it is directly unit-tested (tests/workflow/test_prepare_manifest_targets.py, run by the workflow-selftest prepare-manifest-targets-unit job). No input/schema/rule-ID surface changed. v1.6.0 is WP-SCP-028 Phase 2 (the companion materialisation / FIRING step for the D-058 auth domain): an additive Option-A `opa eval` repo-level pass in policy-check.yml materialises input.canonical_sdk_versions + input.auth_contract (fetched from the PUBLIC estate-canonicals surface per D-061 and cosign-verified against CT's contract-manifest-publish.yml keyless identity — Decision A, BOTH canonicals signed; the *_verified flags derive ONLY from the workflow's own cosign exit, never adopter content) + input.adopter_* (workflow-extracted), then merges SCP-R-009/010/011 findings into policy-findings.json and adds those three rules to BOTH WARN_BASELINE_RULES sites (the coupling guard). The three auth rules now FIRE warn-baseline in production (were dormant/vacuous at v1.5.0). The conftest per-file pass (SCP-R-001..008) is untouched. Additive minor (firing previously-dormant rules; no rule-ID/schema surface change). End-to-end fixtures: tests/workflow/fixture-scp-r-028-{pass,import-fence,trust-boundary}. D-059 reserved for the post-4-week-observation deny-promotion outcome. v2.0.0 (WP-SCP-025 Phase 2 / amended D-053) is the first MAJOR: (1) NEW rule SCP-R-012 (protected-table-migration-marker) born at DENY — destructive Alembic/raw-SQL DDL in a versions/ migration without the `# scp:protected-table-attested` marker blocks merge (new-deny-rule = MAJOR per VERSIONING.md; reversible per-adopter via rule-config disable/threshold-override). (2) The feed is now rule-DECLARED: policies/rule-inputs.yaml is the rule input contract — each content rule (SCP-R-003 envelope) declares the files it needs and scp_policy_check_prepare_manifest_targets surrogates the union; previously the feed hardcoded the three vendoring-manifest basenames, silently starving SCP-R-008 (.env) and any future content rule of input (the inert-feed P0). A missing/malformed contract HARD-FAILS SCP-E002 in CI rather than narrowing the feed. (3) SCP-R-008 STAYS warn-baseline (amended D-053, operator decision 2026-06-10): v2.0.0 is the release that first makes it fire at all, so it earns deny on real-traffic evidence, not on the same release that unblinds it. v2.1.0 is WP-SCP-037 ARCH-006 (the companion materialiser / FIRING step for the D-058 FIRST ONTOLOGY domain, FUP-WP-SCP-037-ARCH-006-MATERIALISER-001): an additive Option-A `opa eval` repo-level pass in policy-check.yml ('Materialise ontology-canonical inputs and evaluate ARCH-006 (SCP-R-013)') extracts input.ontology_contract from services.yml, greps input.ontology_source_markers, derives input.ontology_consumer (gated off for authoring sources), and injects the SCP-owned input.ontology_authoring_allowlist (fashion-ontology-service + fashion-labelling-agent + kg-studio) + full-identity input.repo_id ($GITHUB_REPOSITORY; identity-gated ontology-repo-id selftest seam), then merges SCP-R-013 findings into policy-findings.json. SCP-R-013 has been in BOTH WARN_BASELINE_RULES sites since §1a (v2.0.x) but ran DORMANT/vacuous until this step; it now FIRES warn-baseline in production. No cosign/fetch (structural LINKAGE checks read only the adopter tree). Additive minor (firing a previously-dormant rule; no rule-ID/schema surface change; one new optional workflow input ontology-repo-id, default ""). The conftest per-file pass (SCP-R-001..008) is untouched. End-to-end fixtures: tests/workflow/fixture-scp-r-013-{embedded,compliant,carveout,no-self-assert}. Version-pin conformance stays advisory until FOS publishes a signed version manifest; deny-promotion reserved to a future D-NNN. v2.2.0 is WP-ESC-012b: a NEW warn-baseline rule SCP-R-031 (estate-context-marker-linkage; D-058 canonical-conformance, control-tower authority domain) that gates the presence of the canonical Estate-context bootstrap marker '<!-- canonical:estate-context-bootstrap v1 -->' in BOTH CLAUDE.md AND AGENTS.md (the whole point vs SCP-R-030, which gates CLAUDE.md only), plus a STATIC-MARKER negative check that no dynamic Estate state (workspace_id/org_id/principal/sha256:/digest/freshness/expires_at/observed_at/watermark) leaks into the top-of-file block. Additive-rule MINOR. SCP-R-031 ships loaded + added to BOTH WARN_BASELINE_RULES sites, but vacuous-passes in production until a companion workflow PR materialises input.rule_config + input.claude_md* + input.agents_md* into the evaluation envelope and adds SCP-R-031 to the REPO_LEVEL_RULES eval set (the SCP-R-006/030 safe-failure precedent; warn-baselined-but-not-materialised is the SAFE coupling direction — never blocks). control-tower owns the contract (contracts/estate-context-marker.md); SCP gates LINKAGE only (D-058). End-to-end fixtures: tests/workflow/fixture-scp-r-031-{marker-present-both,marker-absent-claude,marker-absent-agents,dynamic-state-present,disabled}. Deny-promotion reserved to a future operator decision (mirrors SCP-R-030's D-060 note).
_schema_note: No JSON Schema $schema URL — version-manifest.json is a load-bearing public surface (every adopter wrapper at 020H.1+ reads this at workflow run time) but the shape is small and stable; fields are documented in policies/VERSIONING.md and ADOPT-001 §12.7.11. If the surface grows, file a schema at schemas/version-manifest.schema.json (closes 020H.1 R1 COR-MANIFEST-002).
